verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents evidence requests that can take attachments, comments and status updates. It also documents control owners responsible for each control, with roadmap views filterable by owner. That gives manual evidence a basic tracked workflow with ownership at the control level. Reminders are documented only for access reviews tied to policy timelines, not for manual evidence artifacts generally. Nothing in the pack shows due dates, renewal reminders or expiry tracking on individual manual artifacts. Missing for 10: per-artifact owners, due dates, renewal reminders and expiry tracking for manual evidence, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, evidence that can't be automated has a real workflow — owners, due dates, renewal reminders, and expiry tracking on every manual artifact

citations.quote: Add comments, attachments, and status updates to evidence requests
